items.text: Bills ruled out DJ Moore due to shoulder injury (from TNF landing hard; X-rays, stinger).
items.implication: Out for remainder; Bills WR depth elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Other Bills receivers see more targets/snaps.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (rib injury), making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1 hit; two DNPs.
items.implication: High chance inactive; boosts other Chargers pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Tre' Harris primary beneficiary per ETR waivers; also Quentin Johnston.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight missed practice. Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR. If Flowers out, Ravens WR hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore.
items.why: Hamstring; day-to-day per coach but two DNPs lean toward sitting vs Saints.
items.implication: Questionable with lean out; Mark Andrews already seeing volume.
items.opportunity: Bateman and others elevated routes/targets if Flowers inactive.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors don't believe serious but status for Sunday vs Bengals in jeopardy. Listed DNP Thursday after limited Wednesday; diagnosed Grade 1 strain.
items.why: Hamstring injury in practice; history of missing 5 games on IR with hammy in 2024; Grade 1 but availability uncertain pending Friday.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 2; monitor Friday practice closely.
items.opportunity: Routes last week 37/42 dropbacks; if out, elevated targets for Kayshon Boutte, Xavier Hutchinson, Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after missing Week 1 (ankle). Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown (ankle) on IR; strong upcoming matchups PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ/CHI/MIA/GB/DET before bye.
items.why: Full practice indication; timing with Brown IR and schedule.
items.implication: Potential shared/committee backfield with upside for Henderson as explosive option.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes/goal-line chance vs Stevenson; handcuff value elevated.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee surgery (meniscus trim); has yet to practice since.
items.why: Meniscus trim ~1 week ago; no practice yet.
items.implication: Trending questionable/out; Michael Mayer main beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Mayer snaps/routes/targets spike if Bowers out.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited participant second consecutive day (back injury/tightness); earlier said expects to play Sunday at Houston.
items.implication: Likely plays but monitor Friday; CIN pass game volume if limited.
items.opportunity: If sits, backup QB impact on Chase/Higgins.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: In Chiefs debut 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career); 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted. vs IND who gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage/target share in new offense; soft matchup.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in first game under Kubiak (tied Bijan for league lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare.

Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse); others including Vele, Sadiq.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping for available players.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS: Averaged 21.3 PPG home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1. DAL top-5 implied total (27) in high-total game (50.5).
items.why: Home smash spot vs vulnerable secondary; high total.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks Week 1. TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR to Jets WRs; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last season.
items.why: Strong usage + soft secondary matchup after tough W1.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC. Utilization RB9 Week 1.
items.why: Expanded receiving/red-zone role over Gainwell; favorable matchup.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts W1 (most fantasy pts via air). Kamara expected back squeezes passing role; 8.5-pt underdogs not run-friendly script.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return; tough script/matchup.
items.implication: Sit/fade; reverse prior beneficiaries if Kamara in.
